wish: someone should make a tower defense game where birth control methods defend against sperm
spec:
Dots cross a 5x5 board toward a goal; you spend coins on methods placed in cells, each stopping a passing dot with its typical-use effectiveness.
Pick a method, tap a cell to place it, tap Remove then a cell to sell; five dots through ends the game and waves grow.
It is a game, not advice: no medical guidance, nothing stored but the best wave.
notes: Effectiveness values are typical-use figures per pass; the game is a loose illustration, not guidance.
